new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role

• Design and develop embedded software in a real-time operating system environment for a low Earth orbit satellite network
• Architect and implement critical satellite functions including power management, hardware interfaces, and autonomous control
• Collaborate closely with hardware teams to support board bring-up, integration testing, and system deployment across the entire software development life cycle

What You'll Need

• 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one programming language
• Experience leading the design or architecture of new and existing systems
• Background in mentoring or leading engineering teams

What's On Offer

• Annual base salary of $168,100 - $227,400 per year, plus sign-on payments, stock units, and comprehensive benefits
• Flexible work arrangements supporting a hybrid schedule
